title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
description: This theatrical concert from the Springfield Symphony Orchestra brings composer Maurice Ravel and his contemporaries Claude Debussy and George Gershwin to life onstage. Created by Alice Wiley Pickett for actors, singers, and orchestra, it is both comic and poignant, following Ravel's rise to fame amid the arts and sciences boom of early 20th-century Paris. Official tickets are sold online at HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
